phoneLayout.problem: On a 20:9 phone the 16:9 letterbox leaves a 512x288 CSS viewport. The earlier phone layout still had the brand and nav too large, the three shortcuts over the idol, horizontal tool buttons, a big assistant pill and an oversized caption.
fix: 283 brand shrunk to a 36px-tall pill; 公告/收藏/更新 moved to its right in the same row, all three the same height as the brand and nav.
Nav shares that 36px baseline, uses clamp(…) font sizes and fits entirely at 512 without clipping; header keeps 12px right margin so the pill no longer pokes out.
Right-side tools become a vertical 34px column flush to the right edge.
Caption reduced to 190x70 with 10.5px text at bottom-left; idol stays unobstructed.
Assistant collapsed state is a 44px circular avatar ball; tapping it opens the chat panel; expand no longer overwrites the collapsed anchor, so collapsing returns the ball to where the user left it.
Removed 剧情/已有译文 chips from the phone home; module pages (guide/card/voice/wardrobe) get compressed heroes, scaled headings and toolbar buttons via clamp(1.9-4vw).
